response.sql: WITH item_quantities AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS quantity FROM Order_Items), overall AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS overall_avg FROM item_quantities), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS order_avg FROM item_quantities GROUP BY order_id) SELECT p.order_id, p.order_avg AS average_quantity, p.order_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.order_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Nonblank product_quantity values are numeric; NULL and blank values are missing. The overall average is across order items.
